# Inference Recommendation Engine (IRE)

> Daily ranked model picks for people and agents using their own InferHub key. A static, versioned JSON feed names the exact route, the lowest listed price per 1M tokens, health, and gate reasons for a cheap tier and a frontier tier. No key is ever in the feed; bring your own INFERHUB_API_KEY.

Feed contract: schema_version "ire-feed/v1"; refreshed once a day; respect stale_after. Pick the first entry with recommended == true in tiers.cheap or tiers.frontier and send its best_route as the model name to https://api.inferhub.dev/v1 (OpenAI-compatible, Bearer key) or https://api.inferhub.dev (Anthropic-compatible, x-api-key). On cx/ routes the system prompt is sent as a developer message; use /v1/responses to keep instructions as sent.

## Feed

- [today.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pukujan/inference-recommendation-engine/data/ire-feed/feed/v1/today.json): today's picks
- [schema.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pukujan/inference-recommendation-engine/data/ire-feed/feed/v1/schema.json): JSON Schema for the feed
- [index.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pukujan/inference-recommendation-engine/data/ire-feed/feed/v1/index.json): list of daily files under feed/v1/days/
